config.authority: separate OS process; serialized ledger; global and per-tenant epochs; policy wait split half before and half after the snapshot
config.revoker: separate OS process; spins to an absolute CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW target, then commits at the authority
config.phantom: stable trials commit a non-indexed ID owned by tenant t99, never queried: identical schedule/load to race trials, no effect on any queried tenant
config.fence: F: P then a fence over returned IDs with per-tenant epoch fast path; Fg: same with global epoch; if a fence drops an ID, rerun P once and fence again; if the second fence drops, return the remaining IDs
config.victim: query's top eligible document under the base 10% revocation (usually the query's own support record)
